title: Collaborative Memory Augmentation for Generative Recommendation

problem.claim: Generative recommendation models item transitions as a sequence-to-sequence task.

gap.claim: Existing frameworks primarily model individual user sequences within a constrained internal parametric space and do not explicitly leverage cross-user collaborative signals.

contributions.claim: OMEGA is a collaborative memory augmentation framework for generative recommendation that bridges implicit parametric knowledge and explicit collaborative signals.
OMEGA compresses sequential user behavior with learnable query tokens and aggregates the representations into a collaborative memory bank.
OMEGA retrieves memories using sequence-level and target-level similarities and fuses them with local user context through gated cross-attention.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The compressed representations significantly reduce storage overhead.
The gated integration module mitigates interference from noisy patterns.
On multiple real-world datasets, OMEGA significantly outperforms existing advanced generative recommendation models.

narrative_sequence.summary: Generative recommendation models item transitions as sequence-to-sequence prediction.
Existing approaches focus on individual user sequences and omit explicit cross-user collaborative signals.
OMEGA augments generative recommendation with collaborative memory to connect parametric knowledge and collaborative signals.
The framework compresses user behavior, stores global patterns, retrieves relevant memories, and integrates them with local context.
The authors report superior performance to advanced generative recommendation models on multiple real-world datasets.
